deadline.value: Positions are advertised individually when funding is available; there are no fixed dates, and an advert appears at least three weeks before the deadline.
deadline.quote: There are no fixed dates at which the advertisements are posted, but it will always be at least three weeks before the deadline for applications

gre_subject.value: The astronomy page does not mention the GRE Physics subject test.

supervisor.value: The astronomy page sets no rule on supervisor agreement before admission.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students receive a monthly scholarship or salary. Admission itself needs financing for the whole four-year period.
funding.quote: Once a student has been admitted to PhD studies, he or she receives a monthly scholarship or salary

also.quote: Admission to PhD studies requires that adequate financing exists for the student's salary (or similar) during the whole four-year period

entry_route.value: Either a master's (MSc) degree, or 240 credits including one year at advanced level, with physics, mathematics or technical subjects and a degree project of at least 30 credits.
entry_route.quote: either have a degree at advanced (MSc) level
